SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickName, U.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, U.POINT AS point,
G.GRADE_ID AS gradeId, G.GRADE_NAME AS gradeName, G.MIN_AMOUNT AS minAmount, G.DISCOUNT_RATE AS discountRate, G.DESCRIPTION AS description, G.BENEFIT_TEXT AS benefitText FROM `USER` U LEFT JOIN USER_GRADE G ON U.GRADE_ID = G.GRADE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT GRADE_ID AS gradeId, GRADE_NAME AS gradeName, MIN_AMOUNT AS minAmount, DISCOUNT_RATE AS discountRate, DESCRIPTION AS description, BENEFIT_TEXT AS benefitText FROM USER_GRADE ORDER BY GRADE_ID ASC

SELECT FAQ_ID AS faqId, QUESTION AS question, ANSWER AS answer, CATEGORY AS category, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM FAQ WHERE FAQ_ID IN (5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ORDER BY FAQ_ID ASC
